audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Ziggs five of seven stages (Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs) in a lane the mirror recorded Kled winning 54.25%.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror flipped Level 2 through First item to Kled on both layers; that is the range where his trap, double-dash Jousting and remount out-pace a 20s Satchel.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Kled as one atomic group, matched full/content pairs, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stage whys were generic Ziggs boilerplate with no Kled numbers, despite the packet showing sequencing cues elsewhere.
audit.why: Bear Trap 11s at rank 1 (7s at rank 5), Jousting 13s at 550 with a recast, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140s at 3500 range are the spikes that actually move this lane.
audit.corrected: phases[1..5].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] rewritten around those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that both champions carry displacement and that the first one landed decides the trade, never mentions Jousting's recast dashing back through the target, and never flags Violent Tendencies as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is Ziggs' only escape at 20s against an 11s hook; a Ziggs player who does not know the recast exists thinks one Satchel breaks the engage.
audit.corrected: Displacement race stated in report[5]; the Jousting recast in phases[2].why; the Violent Tendencies wind-up tell in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about Grievous Wounds, although Kled restores Skaarl's health by fighting and remounts with a portion of it.
audit.why: Chip damage into a remounting Kled is undone unless anti-heal is up.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 and yanks you from 800 — your Satchel is 20s, so you cannot answer every hook.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Kled can't read the angle.
edits.after: Jousting dashes 550 and recasts to dash back through you — a minefield behind you covers only the first half of that.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Kled below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track Bear Trap on a Rope before every step-up.
edits.after: Chip him below 60%, but count Bear Trap: 8s at rank 4 against your 14s Satchel — step up only inside that gap in his hook.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! travels 3500 on a 140s cooldown and shields him — hold Satchel for the ram, never spend it on poke.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Kled now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Torch burn is real, but he restores Skaarl by fighting and remounts — have Grievous Wounds before you commit to a kill.

edits.before: Track Kled’s Bear Trap on a Rope: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 and reaches 800; your Satchel is 20s. Both displace — whoever lands theirs first owns the trade.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. It governs your forward steps. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1 and 7s at rank 5 — the hook starts his all-in, so step up only on its downtime. - Jousting is 13s and recasts back through you. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s. Never spend Satchel on poke.

edits.before: That is Kled’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies' wind-up is the tell — step back on the animation, not the cast.

edits.before: Level 2 it's a skill fight over whether he lands Q Bear Trap to pull you in.
edits.after: Level 2 his Bear Trap reaches 800 and yanks you into mounted burst.

edits.before: Level 3 stays even as your W escapes fight his pull-and-dismount pressure.
edits.after: Level 3 Jousting closes 550 and returns, so one W will not save you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your poke edge holds while you can W away his engages.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 his trap is 8s while your Satchel is 14s — he wins that.

notes: Only 3 games in the packet, so the chart follows the mirror rather than the win rate. diffRating stays 7/10, which now agrees with a Kled-favoured chart; the mirror lowered Kled's own difficulty to 5/10, so the two sides are consistent. Satchel Charge's derived percentHealth flag is not supported by Riot's description (magic damage plus knockback only) — no max-health claim written, matching the mirror's caution.
